description: Describe a situation and Memegician's AI picks the best-fitting templates, writes the captions and returns 6 finished memes. Requires signing in to Memegician; each call uses 1 credit from the user's account (new accounts get 15 free). Use this when the user wants several ready-made options; use search_meme_templates + render_meme to make one specific meme for free.

situation.description: What the memes should be about, e.g. "my code works on the first try"

name: generate_memes
title: Generate memes with AI (uses 1 credit)
